name: @atlasauth/pca-less-wasm
description: EXPERIMENTAL code-based (syndrome-decoding / code-equivalence) signature backend for @atlasauth/pca: the official LESS reference implementation (NIST additional-signatures candidate, round 1/2) compiled to wasm32-wasi. Adds a genuine third hardness family (beyond lattice + hash). NOT standardized, NOT production-audited.

scripts.build:wasm: echo 'wasm is cross-compiled off-box by ~/.pca-vm-state/lessbuild.sh on a Linux VM (needs wasi-sdk-25). Drop the result into wasm/less_cat1.wasm.' && exit 1
